title: Emails with or about LexisNexis (Steele Sheriff)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting emails between your agency and LexisNexis Risk Solutions, and emails concerning LexisNexis Risk Solutions.

1) Domains: all emails between your agency and "@lexisnexis.com", "@lexisnexisrisk.com", or "@lnssi.com". Timeframe: June 15, 2026 through the date this request is completed.

2) Keywords: all emails containing "LexisNexis", "AVCC", "Accurint Virtual Crime Center", or "Lexis Nexis" in the subject or body. Timeframe: June 15, 2026 through the date this request is completed. We recommend searching "Accurint Virtual Crime Center" as a quoted phrase rather than as separate words, so the results do not include every email containing "crime" or "center."

3) Include: emails, attachments, inline and embedded images, links, and the subject and to/from/cc lines. Please provide the original emails in full.

4) Exclude: Duplicates and mass-mailings may be de-duplicated so that only a single representative example is produced. If your agency receives automated, repeating status or upload-confirmation messages, please include a sample of three rather than the full set. Some agencies receive an automated message every time a data upload to LexisNexis completes. At some departments that runs past 1,400 messages a month. We want to establish the frequency and see an example, not receive thousands of identical emails. Automated password reset and account notification emails may be excluded.

5) Format: if possible, please provide the original electronic files (.eml, .msg, .mbox, .pst, or a similar native format) so the integrity of the original messages is preserved. 

6) If any emails are withheld in whole or in part, please include a list of what was withheld and cite the specific exemption relied on for each.

7) If you coordinate or discuss the response to this request with LexisNexis in any way, please include the email, text message, meeting invite, or other media showing the conversation you had with LexisNexis relating to this request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal

title: MN Fusion Center - Emails with "Antifa" or NPS

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

All emails or attachments that contain the term "Fascist" or "Antifa" or "NSPM7" or "NSPM-7" from August 1, 2026 through November 5, 2026. Please search the body and subject line of the email, and contents of attachments where possible, or at least the names of attachments. Please include emails in original format, or inbox format (.msg, .pst, etc.) where possible. That reduces conversion time for you, and maintains links, images, formatting, attachments, and headers. If you do convert the emails from their original formatting, please include original links, images, formatting, attachments, and headers. 

Please include inboxes of MNFC staff, analysts, and leadership. The aim of this request is to look for narrow terms in a narrow time window. Thank you for your help with this request!

title: Elmira PD - Contracts with Data Brokers and Surveillance Companies

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting records of the Elmira City Police’s contracts and payments with the vendors listed below. If your agency holds no records for a particular vendor, please say so for that vendor rather than for the request as a whole.

1) Contracts, agreements, purchase orders, subscription or license agreements, addenda, amendments, and memoranda of understanding between your agency and any of the following vendors that were in effect at any time during the period:

- LexisNexis Risk Solutions (including RELX, LexisNexis Risk Management, Accurint, Accurint Virtual Crime Center, PSDEX, Community Crime Map)
- SoundThinking (including ShotSpotter, Forensic Logic, CrimeTracer, COPLINK, COPLINK X, CaseBuilder)
- Thomson Reuters (including CLEAR, Thomson Reuters Special Services, West Publishing)
- Motorola Solutions, limited to license plate reader and data sharing products (including Vigilant Solutions, Digital Recognition Network, DRN, LEARN, PlateSearch)
- Flock Safety (including Flock Group Inc.)
- Clearview AI (including add-ons through LexisNexis Public Safety Marketplace)
- Axon Enterprise, limited to Fusus and other real-time crime center or data sharing products (including Fusus, Axon Fusus, TASER International)
- Palantir Technologies 
- Cellebrite

2) Invoices, payment records, and purchase orders issued by or paid to any of the vendors listed above during the period of January, 2025 through the date this request is fulfilled. Please note that we only request two records maximum per company. If you make monthly payments, we do not need every document - just two separate examples of regular payments made to the company.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal

title: Joplin PD Contracts with Surveillance or Data Sharing Companies

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Missouri Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting records of the City of Joplin’s contracts with the vendors listed below, for the period January 1, 2024 through the date this request is fulfilled. If your agency holds no records for a particular vendor, please say so for that vendor rather than for the request as a whole.

1) A contract document between your agency and the following entities. The contract, MSA, PSA, Schedule A, or other similar document will suffice. We are not requesting every contract document, only the first one you find that signifies your agency has a relationship with any of these companies:

- LexisNexis Risk Solutions (including RELX, LexisNexis Risk Management, Accurint, Accurint Virtual Crime Center, PSDEX, Community Crime Map)
- SoundThinking (including ShotSpotter, Forensic Logic, CrimeTracer, COPLINK, COPLINK X, CaseBuilder)
- Thomson Reuters (including CLEAR, Thomson Reuters Special Services, West Publishing)
- Motorola Solutions, limited to license plate reader and data sharing products (including Vigilant Solutions, Digital Recognition Network, DRN, LEARN, PlateSearch)
- Flock Safety (including Flock Group Inc.)
- Clearview AI
- Axon Enterprise, limited to Fusus and other real-time crime center or data sharing products (including Fusus, Axon Fusus, TASER International)
- Cellebrite

We are aware the Joplin charges high fees for public records requests, making city and police data difficult to obtain. We designed this request to be simple, quick, and require an hour or less of your time.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
